task.description: HARD GATE. Validate the ISS-106 test design. Verify: (1) the single MUST requirement ISS-106 has a runnable integration test under tests/integration/ covering attempt column, status CHECK accept+reject (incl. legacy 'pending' and 'BOGUS'), index presence, and full-contract round-trip; (2) NO error.SkipZigTest on ISS-106 coverage; (3) all fixtures use per-test UUIDs; (4) tests clean up after themselves (defer); (5) the test fails clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent; (6) the test is in tests/integration/ NOT tests/unit/ and is wired into the integration target (main_test.zig + build.zig); (7) the ISS-205 claim/outbox path is correctly NOT tested here. Run python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration and confirm no BLOCKER/MAJOR for the new file.
acceptance_criteria: ISS-106 has a runnable integration test covering all 5 assertions
Per-test UUID fixtures; defer cleanup; clear failure if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent
Test in tests/integration/ and wired into the integration target

result.summary: ISS-106 test design validated. The single MUST requirement has a runnable integration test (tests/integration/iss106_webhook_outbox_test.zig) covering all five contract assertions: attempt column type/default (TC-01), status CHECK accepts PENDING/DELIVERED/FAILED/RETRYING (TC-02), status CHECK rejects out-of-domain BOGUS AND legacy lowercase pending via SAVEPOINT (TC-03), idx_wd_status_next_attempt index presence on (status, next_attempt_at) (TC-04), and full-contract row round-trip (TC-05). No error.SkipZigTest on coverage (only an out-of-scope explanatory comment). All fixtures use per-test UUIDs via randomUuidStr with no shared mutable state. Each test registers defer cleanupTenant before provisioning (cleanup survives failure). testDbUrl returns error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl with a printed diagnostic when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent. The test lives in tests/integration/ and is wired into the integration target: imported in main_test.zig (line 148, referenced 216), registered in build.zig (test at 905, wired to test-integration step at 933, plus a dedicated test-integration-iss106 step at 984). The ISS-205 transactional-outbox INSERT and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED worker-claim are correctly excluded, matching the backlog (ISS-106 test plan: insert/claim path exercised by ISS-205). lint_test_isolation reports BLOCKER=0 and all 62 MAJORs are in pre-existing OTHER files (adp09, env01/03, ext03, iss101/102, spt01, svc01-04, tm01) — none attributable to the ISS-106 file.

issues.description: Pre-existing (not ISS-106): lint_test_isolation.py reports 62 MAJOR hardcoded-UUID / shared-var / missing-DB-URL issues across other integration test files (e.g. iss101, iss102, svc01-04, env01/03, adp09, ext03, tm01). Outside this handoff's gate but noted for backlog hygiene.
